commands.name: test
commands.description: Run dotnet test using a selected PostgreSQL installation or all registered versions.

options.name: --pg
options.description: PostgreSQL major version (13–19; default: project selection, otherwise 18).

options.name: --pg-config
options.description: Use this pg_config instead of a registered installation.

options.description: MSBuild configuration, including custom configurations. [default: Debug]

options.name: --all
options.description: Run sequentially against every registered PostgreSQL version. [default: False]

options.name: --no-schema
options.description: Reuse the last successful test schema while rebuilding compatible native code. [default: False]

options.name: --results-directory
options.description: Test report root; each PostgreSQL major gets its own subdirectory.

options.name: --pgdata
options.description: Base directory for isolated, per-invocation PostgreSQL cluster data.

options.description: Initialize and run the test servers as this Unix account through sudo -u; --pgdata must be writable by it.

arguments.name: TEST_ARGUMENTS
arguments.description: Ordinary dotnet test arguments after --, including project selection, filters and report options.
